title: Descende, calve, ut ne amplius decalveris
html_source: Go down, O bald one, lest you be made more bald

anchor.text: Descende, calve, ut ne amplius decalveris
anchor.prefix: yhnhnm, horsenostrilled. The oval equine faces, Temple, Buck Mulligan, Foxy Campbell, Lanternjaws. Abbas father, furious dean, what offence laid 1961#39fire to their brains? Paff!
anchor.suffix: A garland of grey hair on his comminated head see him me clambering down to the footpace (descende!), clutching a monstrance, basiliskeyed. Get down, bald poll! A choir gives back
anchor.canonical_text: Descende, calve, ut ne nimium decalveris.
